mapper.select: SELECT memory_key, memory_value FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory SET memory_value = #{value}, source_conversation_id = #{conversationId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory(user_id, memory_key, memory_value, source_conversation_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{key}, #{value}, #{conversationId})
